title: Webhook Echo
content:
Handling webhooks securely is complex. You need to verify signatures, handle retries, and parse payloads. Echo solves this by providing a standardized receiver for providers like Stripe, GitHub, and custom HMAC sources.

Installation

bun add @gravito/echo

Stripe Example

Echo provides a pre-built driver for Stripe that handles signature verification automatically.

import { Echo, StripeDriver } from '@gravito/echo'

const echo = new Echo({
  drivers: {
    stripe: new StripeDriver(process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
  }
})

app.post('/webhooks/stripe', async (c) => {
  // Verify and parse in one step
  const event = await echo.driver('stripe').verify(c.req)
  
  if (event.type === 'payment_intent.succeeded') {
    // Handle payment
  }
  
  return c.json({ received: true })
})
